title: Educational and Fun!
text: Andreas was amazing.....an excellent teacher and olive oil sommelier!  In excellent English, he described the olive oil making process and classifications prior to our tasting.  We sampled 4 oils contrasting and comparing their flavor profiles.  By the end of the tasting I could actually appreciate the difference between the high quality extra virgin olive oil and the others.  It was intimate, educational and fun!
author: Joan_C

title: Best olive oil in Spain
text: What a great experience….we tasted olive oil with the owner of the company. We learned so much. Thank you for taking the time to teach us about the process and how to taste.
author: Trisha_T
